skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic operations and functions of a Central Bank.
Learn how to manage monetary policy through Central Bank activities.
Understand the process and implications of currency issuance by Central Banks.
Gain knowledge on conducting open market operations as part of Central Bank responsibilities.
Learn about credit operations and their role in Central Bank functions.
Understand the management of foreign exchange by Central Banks.
Learn about the supervision and regulation of banks by Central Banks.
